name: Suzhou Sepax Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Sepax Technologies Co., Ltd., a high-tech company, engages on the research, development, production, and sale of liquid chromatography materials and technologies worldwide. Its products are chromatographic columns and chromatographic fillers used in the analysis, detection, separation and purification of biological macromolecule drugs and small molecule chemical drugs. The company's analytical chromatography products are used for analytical testing in drug development and quality inspection. Suzhou Sepax Technologies Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
